# Bloomwik Hub

> An editorial multilingual blog covering travel, fashion, food, technology and culture. Stories are written in English and translated into 15 languages on demand.

Bloomwik Hub publishes long-form editorial articles for curious readers worldwide. Every article carries a clear category, author, publication date, and the country/region it is set in. The site supports 15 interface languages with hreflang tags and an AI-powered article translator.

## Pages

- [Home](/): featured story, latest stories, and per-category strips
- [About](/about): masthead and editorial mission
- [Contact](/contact): pitches, partnerships, press

## Categories

- [Travel](/category/travel): field notes from the road, the rail and the runway
- [Fashion](/category/fashion): style as language — read between the seams
- [Food](/category/food): recipes, restaurants and rituals around the table
- [Technology](/category/technology): tools, ideas and the people building tomorrow
- [Culture](/category/culture): art, music, books and the conversation around them
